svg.title: Ashish Kumar Gupta — Discord Bots
svg.desc: Showcase of FLOSS music bot, KALYUG security and support bot, and TicketHub ticketing bot. All three logos are embedded directly in this SVG.

g.text: Serving millions of listeners with a smooth, scalable audio experience.
Engineered for reliable playback and high concurrency.
Built for communities, game servers, and hosting providers.
Organized ticket workflows with secure permission handling.
Multi-panel support in one powerful bot
Manage tickets, streamline support, and organize staff workflows.
Packed with features for an efficient community support system.

svg.text: THREE BOTS • THREE WORKFLOWS • BUILT BY ASHISH
